verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say developers can create deposit accounts on its platform and build directly on it using APIs, so the core capability is first-party. Beyond that, the evidence is thin marketing copy. missing for 10: evidence that the accounts are FDIC-insured, a documented application-to-active-account API flow (customer application, KYC, approval), a sandbox environment with parity to production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch

citations.quote: Create deposit accounts and wallet accounts held in FBO structures.
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components, with control over their product experience and operating model.
Issue cards, open accounts, move money, extend credit.
